name: PDFMonkey
label: PDFMonkey API — template documents
description: PDFMonkey API — template documents. Official API https://pdfmonkey.io/docs/api/. One node; pick operation. Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. Template-based HTML/PDF. Generated files stay on PDFMonkey until deleted. List templates via GET /document_template_cards. Download is a signed download_url on the document/card (valid 1 hour), not a dedicated /download path. document_download OUTPUT is type file (platform file ref-id; never inline bytes or base64).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port. File bytes are type file.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: document_generate, document_get, document_list, document_download, template_list.

schema.label: document_template_id
schema.description: document_generate required template id. Nested as document.document_template_id. Example: 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111.

schema.label: payload
schema.description: document_generate template variables. Nested as document.payload (https://pdfmonkey.io/docs/api/#create-a-document). Example: {"name":"Ada","total":"19.00"}.

schema.label: meta
schema.description: document_generate optional document.meta (internal refs). Nested via bodyMap. Example: {"order_id":"1001"}.

schema.label: status
schema.description: document_generate. EXACT: pending (generate now) | draft (save). Nested as document.status. Example: pending.

schema.label: id
schema.description: URL path parameter `id` for operations: document_get, document_download. Required by: document_get, document_download.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: PDFMonkey API key. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.
